diagrams.title: New STRIDE diagram

data.name: User Layer Boundary
data.description: Separates external users from the trusted application and identity infrastructure.

data.name: AI Agent Layer Boundary
data.description: Separates the AI agent execution environment and its credentials from protected internal services.

data.name: Internal API Layer Boundary
data.description: Protects internal APIs, RAG/MCP services, and business data from unauthorised access.

data.name: User
data.description: External customer or employee who accesses the SecureNova AI-powered customer service application. The user authenticates through Auth0 Universal Login using OpenID Connect (OIDC), Authorization Code Flow with PKCE, and MFA where enabled.

data.name: Auth0 Identity Provider
data.description: Auth0 authenticates customers and employees using Universal Login, OIDC, Authorization Code Flow with PKCE, and MFA. It validates credentials and issues ID tokens and access tokens containing user identity and authorization claims.

data.name: Customer Support Request
data.description: Customer or employee submits a request to the SecureNova customer service application.

data.name: Authentication Tokens
data.description: Auth0 returns an ID token and access token after successful authentication. The tokens contain identity and authorization claims.

data.name: M2M Access Token
data.description: Auth0 validates the M2M client and returns a signed access token containing the authorised API scopes.

data.name: Authentication Request
data.description: The application redirects the user to Auth0 Universal Login for authentication using OIDC Authorization Code Flow with PKCE.

threats.title: Authentication Request Tampering
threats.description: An attacker modifies authentication parameters or token-related data to manipulate the login process.
threats.mitigation: Provide remediation for this threat or a reason if status is N/A

threats.title: Credential and Token Exposure
threats.description: User credentials, access tokens, or identity information are exposed through insecure transmission or application logs.
threats.mitigation: Provide remediation for this threat or a reason if status is N/A

threats.title: Authentication Service Overload
threats.description: An attacker sends excessive login requests, preventing legitimate users from accessing the application.
threats.mitigation: Provide remediation for this threat or a reason if status is N/A

data.name: Client Credentials Grant
data.description: The M2M client sends its client authentication credentials to Auth0 and requests an access token with assigned scopes.

threats.title: OAuth Token Request Manipulation
threats.description: An attacker modifies token requests or requested scopes to manipulate authorisation.
threats.mitigation: Provide remediation for this threat or a reason if status is N/A

threats.title: M2M Client Secret Exposure
threats.description: Client secrets or access tokens are exposed through insecure storage, transmission, or logging.
threats.mitigation: Provide remediation for this threat or a reason if status is N/A

threats.title: Auth0 Token Endpoint Overload
threats.description: Excessive token requests overwhelm the authentication endpoint.
threats.mitigation: Provide remediation for this threat or a reason if status is N/A

data.name: M2M Token Request
data.description: The AI Agent requests an OAuth access token using its registered machine-to-machine client credentials.

data.name: LLM Prompt Request
data.description: The AI Agent sends a prompt and relevant context to the external LLM provider, authenticating using the securely retrieved API key.

threats.title: LLM Prompt and Response Tampering
threats.description: An attacker modifies prompts, request parameters, or generated responses to influence agent behaviour.
threats.mitigation: Provide remediation for this threat or a reason if status is N/A

threats.title: LLM API Key and Prompt Exposure
threats.description: API keys, system prompts, or confidential customer information are exposed to unauthorised parties.
threats.mitigation: Provide remediation for this threat or a reason if status is N/A

threats.title: LLM API Quota Exhaustion
threats.description: An attacker generates excessive LLM requests and consumes the available API quota.
threats.mitigation: Provide remediation for this threat or a reason if status is N/A

threats.title: API Request Parameter Tampering
threats.description: An attacker modifies API requests, customer IDs, or request parameters to manipulate backend operations.
threats.mitigation: Provide remediation for this threat or a reason if status is N/A

threats.title: Unauthorised API Data Exposure
threats.description: The API returns confidential customer information to an unauthorised agent or user.
threats.mitigation: Provide remediation for this threat or a reason if status is N/A

threats.title: Internal API Resource Exhaustion
threats.description: Excessive or malicious agent requests overload the internal REST API.
threats.mitigation: Provide remediation for this threat or a reason if status is N/A

data.name: LLM Generated Response
data.description: The LLM provider processes the request and returns the generated response to the AI Agent.

threats.title: RAG Document and Chunk Poisoning
threats.description: An attacker modifies knowledge documents or inserts malicious chunks to manipulate agent responses.
threats.mitigation: Provide remediation for this threat or a reason if status is N/A

threats.title: Unauthorised Knowledge Base Disclosure
threats.description: Confidential documents or restricted knowledge chunks are retrieved by unauthorised users.
threats.mitigation: Provide remediation for this threat or a reason if status is N/A

threats.title: Vector Database Resource Exhaustion

data.name: MCP Tool Response
data.description: The MCP Server returns the result of the executed authorised tool to the AI Agent.

data.name: Authenticated User Request
data.description: The application forwards the authenticated user request and relevant user identity and authorization claims to the AI Agent.

data.name: MCP Tool Request
data.description: The AI Agent sends a tool invocation request with arguments to the MCP Server. The server validates the request and the agent's authorisation before executing the permitted tool.

data.name: User Login Request
data.description: The user submits login credentials through the application to Auth0 Universal Login. Auth0 validates the credentials and performs MFA where enabled.

data.name: Customer Service Application
data.description: SecureNova's customer-facing application that allows customers and employees to access AI-powered customer support. It redirects users to Auth0 for authentication, validates authentication tokens, and forwards authorised requests to the AI Agent.

data.name: AI Agent
data.description: AI-powered customer service agent that receives authenticated user requests, processes instructions using an LLM, retrieves relevant information from the RAG pipeline, and invokes authorised MCP tools and internal REST APIs.

data.name: OAuth M2M Client
data.description: Machine-to-machine OAuth client that authenticates with Auth0 using the Client Credentials Flow to obtain access tokens with specifically assigned API scopes.

data.name: LLM Provider
data.description: External large language model provider that processes prompts and generates responses for the SecureNova AI Agent.

data.name: LLM API Key Vault
data.description: Secure storage containing the provider-issued LLM API key. Access is restricted to authorised services, and the key must not be exposed in prompts, logs, or application responses.

data.name: RAG Pipeline Service
data.description: Retrieval-Augmented Generation service that uses its service identity to retrieve authorised documents and relevant knowledge chunks from the vector knowledge base and provides the retrieved context to the AI Agent.

data.name: Vector Knowledge Base
data.description: Vector database containing indexed SecureNova knowledge documents, embeddings, and information used by the RAG pipeline for similarity-based retrieval.

data.name: MCP Server
data.description: Model Context Protocol server with its own service identity. It exposes approved tools and resources to the AI Agent and forwards authorised tool requests to internal REST APIs.

data.name: Internal REST API
data.description: Protected internal REST API that provides customer service functionality and accesses authorised business data. It validates OAuth access tokens, checks scopes and permissions, and enforces access controls.

data.name: Customer Database
data.description: Secure database containing customer records and service-related information. Access is restricted to authorised internal API operations.

threats.title: MCP Tool Argument and Response Tampering
threats.description: An attacker modifies tool arguments or responses to manipulate internal operations.
threats.mitigation: Provide remediation for this threat or a reason if status is N/A

threats.title: MCP Tool Information Exposure
threats.description: MCP tools expose confidential customer records, credentials, or internal service information.

threats.title: Malicious MCP Tool Execution Loops
threats.description: Repeated or malicious tool invocations exhaust server resources and disrupt services.
threats.mitigation: Provide remediation for this threat or a reason if status is N/A
